stories.title: October inflation report today at 8:30am ET
stories.summary: The US consumer price report for October comes out Tuesday at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok). It shapes whether the Fed raises rates in December, which matters for risk assets like crypto. Bitcoin was below $75,000 on Tuesday morning going into the release, per PANews.
points: Consensus is +0.3% for the month (September +0.6%) and core +0.2% (September +0.3%), per Finviz and ZeroHedge.
Goldman expects +0.21% headline and +0.16% core, per ZeroHedge; the Cleveland Fed nowcast is 0.24% headline and 0.21% core, per BYDFi.
No official year-over-year rate will be published this time, because October 2025 prices were never collected, per BYDFi and ZeroHedge.
Producer prices (PPI) follow on Friday at 8:30am ET, with a forecast of +0.4% for the month (prior +1.3%), per Finviz.

stories.title: Crypto misses the stock rally as $1B+ of long bets get wiped out
stories.summary: US stocks had a strong Monday, but bitcoin and ether lagged. Bitcoin closed last week just below its 50-week average, more than $1 billion of leveraged bets on higher prices were liquidated, and US bitcoin funds lost $1.28 billion last week. Miner MARA also sold 13,597 BTC to pay off its loans.
points: Bitcoin closed the week about 0.7% below its 50-week moving average of $75,488, per Galaxy's Alex Thorn via The Block.
Over 24 hours more than $1.15B of positions were liquidated, $1.04B of them longs; ether accounted for over $500M and bitcoin about $309M, per CoinGlass data via The Block.
US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $1.28B last week, the most since late June, leaving 2026 at $914.1M of net outflows, per The Block.
MARA sold 13,597 BTC, used $750M to fully repay its bitcoin-backed loans and reported Q3 net profit of $634.4M, per The Block.

stories.title: Coinbase gets a full federal trust bank charter
stories.summary: The US bank regulator (OCC) gave Coinbase National Trust Company its final charter, so Coinbase's custody of crypto for institutions now sits under a national regulator. It is a custody change for big clients, not a new retail bank.
points: Preliminary approval came on 2 April, per crypto.news.
The trust must hold at least $60M of Tier 1 capital, per crypto.news.
It cannot take retail deposits, make traditional loans or issue stablecoins, per crypto.news.
Ripple received its final approval on 26 Oct, per crypto.news.
